description: Use for lists of cannabis compounds: find the compounds mapped onto the human body (curated atlas records and database compounds with a measured, sourced value at a target placed in tissue) by name, chemical class, record type or molecular target (for example every compound acting at CB2, TRPV1, 5-HT1A or FAAH, or every terpene). Returns identity, PubChem CID, record type, targets and the atlas url. Use get_compound for one full record. Educational reference, not medical advice.

limit.description: How many items to return, at most 100.

query.description: Part of a name or identifier, for example "cannabidiol", "CBD", "thymol" or "CDB000032". Leave out to list all.

recordType.description: curated (atlas records with reviewed effects and grades) or database (compounds with a measured value at a placed target).

target.description: A receptor, channel or enzyme by name or gene, for example "CB2", "CNR1" or "PPAR-gamma".

name: search_compounds
title: Search compounds
